segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. How can I help today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, hi Maya. This is Ben from Northstar Clinic Group. I just need a copy of our March invoice sent to a different billing email, if possible.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can I get the account name and either the invoice number or the last four digits of the payment method?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Account is Northstar Clinic Group, and the invoice number is INV-48291. I don't have the card in front of me.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: That's fine. I found it in the billing tool. March invoice, issued March 3rd for $1,284.00, covering 42 seats. Is that the one?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's it. Can you send it to ap@northstarclinic.com? The old billing alias is getting retired.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Absolutely. I've sent the PDF to ap@northstarclinic.com, and I also updated that as the billing contact going forward. You'll still keep your admin contact the same, Rachel Kim at northstarclinic.com.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Will April's invoice go there automatically then?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. The next invoice on April 3rd will go to the new AP address. I also added a note on ticket 318744 in case anyone asks later.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, that's all I needed. Thanks for making it quick.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're welcome, Ben. Have a good one.
